featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m posting this complaint to bring a very serious matter to your notice. Despite my continuous efforts to communicate, I unfortunately received a wrong medication from WELLNESS Chemist. I felt compelled to document my grievances socially because I’m worried this act of negligence from WELLNESS CHEMIST could have caused me to terminate my pregnancy medically.
I’m a 3 month young pregnant woman who has been having a complex pregnancy and hence advised to be on a complete bed rest by the doctor so I usually order my all the medications from WELLNESS CHEMIST.
This month on (13/02/24) I was due for my  injectable progesterone which I ordered from the WELLNESS CHEMIST and by misfortune I received a Deca Duraboline injection. Luckily the nurse who came to inject me checked the medication properly and she took me by surprised that it’s not the progesterone which I was supposed to take.
I then and there called up WELLNESS CHEMIST to check on the matter and the response I got from the chemist shook me totally.
Instead of apologizing or sending the correct medication. The person Named Ram replied to me saying “WE HAVE PROJESTERONE 250 mg so you take 250 mg” The chemist had a copy of my prescription. Hence my nurse replied that "how can you suggest a patient to take a half dose when the prescription clearly states it’s 500mg and you are insisting to take 250 mg progesterone that to a high risk pregnant mother” Then the chemist not even apologized for sending the Deca Duraboline instead of progesterone without my permission he sent the progesterone 250mg injection and said "why don’t you come and pick up your own medication".

How can someone even pass this comment to a person who is on complete bed rest to go and collect her own medication.
Forget about collecting medication the person name Ram sent me the wrong medication inspite of having my prescription.
This act of sending totally wrong medication to a High Risk pregnant woman is not acceptable and should be punished by the law as it could have cost me my baby’s life.
The incident could have been rectified by the chemist instead the arrogance what I received.
Inorder to maintain this pregnancy it has costed me lakhs of money.
I would suggest the customers not to opt for wellness chemist unless having a strong medical knowledge. It looks to me more of a GENERAL STORE  RATHER than a CHEMIST.
TODAY IT'S ME, TOMORROW IT MIGHTY BE YOU.
